title: Not as described.
text: Not as described.. This is six tiny glasses, about 4.5" tall. Advertised as 6" tall. The photos show a totally different sized glass than what I received. GRRR! I need these for a party on Saturday and am furious. The photo shows the size, next to a regular ball point pen.

product_metadata.title: Pasabahce Premium Stemmed Mini Clear Wine and Champagne Glasses, Set of 6,Uniqe Desing Goblet 5.75 Oz, Perfect for Parties, Gifts, Housewarming, Weddings, Aniversary
features: BRAND AND QUALITY - Pasabahce is the second glassware producer in the Europe, has been producing unique wine glasses since 1935 with high quality. Pasabahce's product range is including different kind of wine glasses and champagne glasses. Bistro serie is the best representative among all glassware. You will taste better your drink.

BOX DESIGN - Pasabahce focus on very carefully box design. Set of 6 glasses is the gift box in order you can meet your friends and family with regular drink glasses. Bistro series is one of the most preferred wine glasses in different celebration, such as weddings, anniversaires, for people would like to feel special thanks to useful design.

ECO FRIEND - While we are going through difficult days in terms of climate change and global warming, Pasabahce has been producing all items in different factories by considering detrimental impact of mass glassware production. You can make sure that whatever you order from Pasabahce is definitely eco friend. Most of Pasabahce items have recycled glass and our project is to meet our consumer with our Aware Collection which is %100 recycled items with turquoise color in the future.
DURABLE AND DISWASHER – Wine glasses set of 6 can be cleaned up very easily thanks to dishwasher.
DIMENSIONS - 175 cc. 5 3/4 oz US oz. - 6 1/4 UK oz. 132 mm. 5 1/4” - 60 mm. 2 1/4”
